```{r}
curve_files <- list(
  usa = "reconstructed_data/usa-bs.csv",
  gbr = "reconstructed_data/gbr-bs.csv",
  jpn = "reconstructed_data/jpn-bs.csv",
  cad = "reconstructed_data/cad-bs.csv",
  ger = "reconstructed_data/ger-bs.csv",
  fra = "reconstructed_data/fra-bs.csv",
  itl = "reconstructed_data/itl-bs-ib.csv",
  aus = "reconstructed_data/aus-bs-ib.csv"
)

curves <- lapply(curve_files, read.csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}
summarize_curve <- function(curve_name, curve_data) {
  tenor_cols <- setdiff(names(curve_data), "time")
  tenor_data <- lapply(curve_data[tenor_cols], as.numeric)

  curve_stats <- lapply(tenor_cols, function(tenor) {
    values <- tenor_data[[tenor]]

    data.frame(
      curve = curve_name,
      tenor = tenor,
      mean = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
      min = min(values, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25 = unname(quantile(values, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
      median = median(values, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75 = unname(quantile(values, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
      max = max(values, na.rm = TRUE),
      variance = var(values, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })

  do.call(rbind, curve_stats)
}

curve_summary_stats <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(curves), function(curve_name) {
    summarize_curve(curve_name, curves[[curve_name]])
  })
)

row.names(curve_summary_stats) <- NULL
curve_summary_stats
```
